title: Finish the shared std HTTP server for the A2A and leaf surfaces
goal: Complete the destination-first axum removal in Susi core: move the already golden-proven std HTTP/1.1 server into susi-http-transport, make susi-gawd-a2a and susi-leaf-services use it, preserve the A2A and leaf wire goldens, and remove the axum facade only when the affected workspace and guard gates pass.
limitations: Only the native Linux x86_64 host was executed, as required by the current-host mandate; no Windows run was available. The change makes no build-time reduction claim for the four-pillar closure at its e12bc9008 base (39 workspace crates, 141 third-party crates and 15 direct facade edges). tower-service remained at that base because GMCP depended on it; a later main landing removed that facade separately and refreshed GMCP evidence. The shared std HTTP server intentionally serves HTTP/1.1 only, matching its documented contract; no commercial source moved into core.
results: Linux x86_64 on the committed worktree: cargo fmt --all --check exit 0; cargo check --workspace --all-targets --keep-going --offline --locked exit 0; cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --offline --locked -- -D warnings exit 0; cargo deny --offline --locked check licenses exit 0 (licenses ok, with the repository's pre-existing unmatched BSD-2-Clause allowance warning). Acceptance command passed with susi-gawd-a2a 52/0, susi-http-transport 43/0 and susi-leaf-services 39/0 tests, plus zero-failure doc tests. Guards passed: architecture_tests 43, lean_core_ceilings 2, orphan_sources 3, no_github_coupling 5, core_docs_promise_no_ui_or_plugins 5 and task_records 3. The shared std server now serves A2A and all leaf routes; the A2A public card route, auth guards, HEAD handling and wire golden remain correct. The vendor TLS facade exposes one validated identity through both async and blocking accept paths. The workspace removed susi-vendor-axum, susi-vendor-tower and the ten now-unreachable registry packages from Cargo.lock. The leaf-service test harness now serializes every process-environment-mutating test behind its shared async lock, and the default-feature test module is correctly feature-gated.
